name: Proekt "Keramicheskoe serdce"
source: When it became known that the experience of Kayaba Akihiko by transferring his consciousness into the network was successful , the research in this area continued. The main sponsor was the Ministry of Defence, which is very interested in a way to avoid the loss of highly skilled pilots and drivers in armed clashes . An intermediate step was the development of the medical module " Medikuboyd " which monitors the patient's brain and body , removing the data in a more dynamic and gentle , does not lead to the destruction of the brain. The final goal of the experiment was a complete recreation of the individual in the form of implanting artificial intelligence.
